On Singapore Airlines [claiming best airline for a 6th time](https://archives.internationalintrigue.io/p/airline-diplomacy?utm_source=archives.internationalintrigue.io)

“Reclaiming the crown from the Qataris for a sixth win, this news is less about fast wi-fi or tasty satay, and more the fruition of Lee Kuan Yew's big bet back in 1975: that's when the city-state's founder overruled his own advisors and instead opted to sink a frightening 11% of his entire GDP into building what is now Changi Airport.
Why? He understood that a tiny island with no natural resources had its best shot if it could embed itself into global trade. So these days, Singapore handles nearly 2% of the world's international passengers, and the aviation sector underpins ~12% of Singapore's entire GDP when you include flow-on tourism, logistics, and the like.”

Singapore: A blyg among platform states :)
